about: s14/load (D-354): the baked world's units. A unit's source hash covers its entry modules, every module they import under src/ (tools/bake_world/srchash.mjs), and its data inputs; a change to any of them makes its cache entry stale and the page builds it live. Bump version to invalidate by hand. s15 (D-386): the units the build takes synchronously (townplan, mudface, fill, crossings, grime) are preloaded at its start and baked by tools/bake_world/bake.ts from a node build of the world (the collector); 'keyed' says what the runtime key hashes.

impostors.keyed: the held jar and sack geometry hashed into the key at load

mudface.keyed: the parts (partsKey) hashed into the key; each face by the hash of its input geometry and gain

townplan.keyed: v1 (the plan has no runtime input)

fill.keyed: the seed, the town on or off, the number of villages

crossings.keyed: the rivers' lines and the village tracks hashed at load

grime.keyed: the seed, the fires' kinds and places and the street doors hashed at load

reliefshadow.keyed: the shadow items (every relief figure's kind, seed and frame) hashed at load
